hypothesis: Anchor the adapted distribution on its own generated prefixes as well as gold training prefixes to reduce autoregressive drift; no guarantee that training-source stability transfers to evaluation.
objective: Supervised CE +0.5 forward KL(base||student) on training reference prefixes +0.5 forward KL(base||student) on detached student-generated training-source prefixes. Vocabulary sum, nonpadding token mean. One rollout batch of2 per optimizer update.
rollout_sources: Two consecutive original training sources cyclically selected at each step. No validation/test or historical corpus inputs, source corrections or error-specific prompts.
method_scope: Inspired by on-policy distillation; not a reproduction of GKD, not a larger external teacher, and not a causal ablation against8034 because the objective includes an additional training-only loss.

selection.rank: Eligible variants: lowest known confirmed errors, then most complete new-validation fixes, then highest all-validation chrF++, then lower adapter strength. chrF is not semantic approval.
selection.if_no_eligible_variant: Reject this experiment; do not expand the grid using control/test failures.

selection_rule: Select from the three preregistered checkpoints using all25 known validation dialogues as development data. First eligibility gates; then known error count, net new-validation corrections, chrF++, earlier step. Freeze before other controls; reject if none eligible.
